title: Stream dense Z/4 quadratic phases with restored cofactors (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A scoped constructive written proof streams every value of a dense quadratic polynomial on L Boolean address bits with arbitrary Z/4 coefficients, including odd cross coefficients. With N=2^L it uses exactly **4N-2L-4 individual residue additions/subtractions**, restores its constant and linear cofactors on complete exhaustion, and stores no N-entry phase table.

```text
visit the zero cofactor
add the selected linear term and quadratic column
visit the one cofactor
subtract that same column and linear term; return
```

The exact control bill is 4N-3 events, 2(N-L-1) quadratic-coefficient reads and stack peak 3L+1 event records. The input table uses O(L²) bits; event records use O(L log(L+2)) bits. This is a new unpacked cofactor construction and exact arithmetic bill, not a claim of the first linear phase stream: Dugongue #4538 already proves O(N+L) packed-word generation for even cross coefficients. Polynomial cofactoring and Shannon expansion are classical.

The proof and implementation were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit aliromman #5375 for the physical phase-stream interface, Dugongue #4538 for the prior packed-word theorem, pinterbanget #4555 for its published finite check, and the retained jmbarrancoml #2250, JoyboyBrian #5329, 1337isnot1337 and pinterbanget #4325 lineage. Predecessor mathematical results are cited; their executables were not replayed. Three unchanged context documents are SHA256/Git-blob pinned at canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57.

Only `research/dense-quadratic-phase-stream/` is added. The formal-interface-lemma card explicitly changes scope to this algebraic component. The [advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19591502) and [scope/credit clarification](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19591622) record the boundary with the earlier general-dimension theorem. No selected-frontier change or new kappa.

## Evidence

Before this contribution, #5375 supplies a fixed-recipe physical producer and #4538 a packed-gradient theorem with even cross coefficients. This package supplies the arbitrary-Z/4 cofactor producer, an exact individual-residue bill, and an explicit completed-return contract.

- The direct polynomial oracle matches every coefficient choice through L=3: 16,660 cases and 132,132 phases. Another 72 generated fixtures at L=4..12 compare 65,408 phases.
- The L=20 capacity case emits all 1,048,576 phases, executes 4,194,260 updates and 4,194,301 events, and reaches stack peak 61.
- Nine domain controls and six semantic/return controls pass. Four disposable implementation mutations were rejected by polynomial or restoration checks. The direct oracle was written with this package; independent human and proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed.
- Both registered warning-strict normal/optimized commands pass locally, timed at 1.142 and 1.112 seconds. Registered replay, in-memory AST/compile inspection, exact committed bytes/modes/source ancestry, official export integrity and both read-only Git-free exported replays pass. All eleven exported files retain their bytes and modes. Generated stdout receipts bind all seven package files and agree across modes.

Reproduce from the repository root with CPython 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dense-quadratic-phase-stream
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/dense-quadratic-phase-stream/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -O -W error research/dense-quadratic-phase-stream/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/dense-quadratic-phase-stream --check-modes --check-source-history
```

The direct marker is `PASS_DENSE_QUADRATIC_PHASE_STREAM`. Another installation may substitute its CPython 3.12 path. `PROOF.md` establishes the unbounded quantifiers; the executable intentionally accepts L<=20. No local registered check is deferred to CI.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The bill counts individual Z/4 updates and abstract control/access events. It does not certify a fixed-tape tariff, native Clifford realizability for odd cross coefficients, or a physical improvement over #5375. The cofactor return requires complete iterator exhaustion, including the call observing StopIteration; early abandonment cleanup is unclaimed. Public immutable inputs are preserved at every prefix.

Input acquisition, dense-table preparation, source movement, level control, output rotation, affine routing, signed range/common grid, ownership/retirement, precision and the complete caller invoice remain open. The selected five framework assumptions remain. No selected scientific cold replay, predecessor suite, Lean, Docker, full supplier or complete multiplication theorem was run or claimed.

## Open next questions

- Lower a triangular coefficient layout to one fixed finite tape program and account for every access and return, beginning at L=4.
- Bind one actual native recipe and output consumer, then compare the complete preparation, storage, phase and restoration bill before extending the construction.

## Related open work

- #7425 implements the literal outer phase sweep from its encoded header. Its physical source/consumer obligations are separate from this general algebraic stream.
- #7426 implements the selected native quadratic Gaussian phase. This contribution supplies no binding of its new stream to that literal machine or a competing tape count.
- #7501 shares the literal phase/egress tape bank. That physical lifetime result is a separate composition obligation.
- #7503 proves the selected tensor phase's linear-observation minimum. This contribution studies a streaming arithmetic bill and uses none of that result; it computes no competing observation minimum.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `54fb1976450892a194350e5dcd58a41505cd5c24`, [run 43438133981, plan job 131928440565](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43438133981/job/131928440565) failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. I read the job log: it reports 760 tests, exactly one failure and 24 skipped. The failing test is `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`, with an AssertionError that '`make frontier7000-verify`' was not found in the CI verification document.

This failure is present in canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still has the current-family #6030 section and `make frontier6030-verify`. I read those exact main-commit files. This PR changes only its isolated package. The dependent `replay` job was skipped, so hosted CI executed no package replay.

I also read the actual plan logs for [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314/job/130140894651), [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790/job/130134720799), and [run 43437529382](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43437529382/job/131926379166). Each reports the same sole failing test and missing command, with 760 tests and 24 skipped. No claim is made about logs from other runs.

All package evidence above remains local at the unchanged head. No rerun, retrigger commit or shared-file repair was made. The own-open-PR check after CI retained #7501 and #7503 as the phase-related entries above; their tape and observation bounds are separate from this arithmetic bill.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated research package. Shared code, predecessor files and selected certificates remain unchanged.
